high_level_description: The image is divided into two sections. The top section shows a row of mannequins wearing shirts of various colors: red, white, blue, green, gray, black, purple, yellow, and another green. These shirts are displayed outdoors, with a backdrop of trees and a clear sky, suggesting a sunny day. The bottom section of the image presents a thermal imaging view of the same shirts, showing the heat absorption differences between them. The thermal images highlight the varying temperatures of the shirts, with warmer areas appearing in shades of red and orange, and cooler areas in blue and green.
